annotations.title: Match chips to official KiCad footprints

description: Find the official KiCad library footprint for chips from their package numbers. An id comes back only when pin count, pitch and body size agree on source evidence and exactly one official footprint fits; otherwise the status is 'ambiguous' (with the candidates and what separates them) or 'unresolved' (with the reason), and footprint_id is null, because a wrong footprint on a board is worse than none. `choices` records an engineer's pick among the candidates of an ambiguous chip; a pick that is not a candidate is ignored and listed with its reason. Numbers in, library ids out: no job data is read. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

id.description: Your id for the chip, echoed back

choices.description: An engineer's pick for ambiguous chips: chip id to footprint id, honoured only when it is a candidate.
